messages:
incident-bot: Pager — High error rate for private interconnects in gcp-europe-west8. Autoscale triggered. svc: private-connect-east-west

ops-oncall: ack. I'm oncall for the next 30m. gathering context.

netops-lee: seeing intermittent 502/504 from on-prem -> gcp egress. BGP flaps between our colo and gcp-europe-west8 interconnect. Packet drops ~2-5% on a subset of paths.

sre-alex: confirmed increased tail latency on r_proxy for customers with private routes. Error spike started ~15m ago.

marta: any customer impact visible? cs?

support-raj: CS reports 3 customers with elevated 5xx on private endpoints (IDs: C-112, C-228, C-315). Tickets opened, all say timeouts/resets when fetching embeddings.

ops-oncall: can we isolate to specific colo? netops-lee, do we have BGP neighbor flapping logs?

netops-lee: pulling logs now. here's quick tail:
```
bgp-peer 10.1.2.3 RESET (Hold timer expired)
bgp-peer 10.2.3.4 ESTABLISHED
bgp-peer 10.1.2.3 ESTABLISHED
bgp-peer 10.1.2.3 RESET (Update error)
```
looks like one interconnect circuit intermittently resetting.

sre-alex: temporary mitigation: we can steer affected customer traffic to eu-west-other-region via fallback-route policy in the control plane. that avoids the flaky interconnect but increases latency ~40-80ms.

marta: agree. start with C-112 and C-228 who reported timeouts. C-315 is low-priority.

ops-oncall: applying route-policy now. running command:
```
redwood route replace --customer C-112 --to-region europe-west3 --policy fallback-on-egress-error
```

deploy-bot: route-change job queued, will execute across dedicated pools. ETA 2m.

ops-oncall: applied for C-112, monitoring. metrics: error rate dropped 70% for that tenant.

support-raj: updated customers C-112 and C-228 via ticket — ongoing work, told them we may have to keep them on fallback until GCP resolves.

netops-lee: opened ticket with GCP NOC referencing interconnect circuit x-3456. GCP acknowledges anomaly and is investigating hardware path. ETA unknown.

sre-alex: plan: 1) continue selective route steering to non-impacted regions 2) enable aggressive KV-cache for embedding calls for impacted customers to reduce egress 3) schedule a canary rollback path if steering causes regressions.

marta: assign on-call follow-up: netops-lee owns vendor comms, ops-oncall owns route steering, sre-alex owns perf mitigations. I'll coordinate post-incident review.

customer-success-bot: Noted impacted customers and tickets. Flagged for potential SLA credit depending on root cause timeline. :warning:

ops-oncall: handoff to night oncall in 25m. will leave sticky notes in incident doc. any other quick checks?

netops-lee: will ping GCP every 30m and update thread. adding raw tcpdump snippet to incident doc for later analysis.

sre-alex: adding perf dashboards and replay traces. closing on my side once all customers either moved or confirm stable.

incident-bot: incident updated — severity reduced to P2 due to partial mitigation. logs archived to incident/1719999999.

support-raj: customers acknowledging improvement. closing tickets as monitoring.

ops-oncall: handing off to @marta for overnight watch. thanks all. :thumbsup:
